blocks.text: TUGUEGARAO CITY — A total of 11,144 rice farmers from 14 towns and this city received P5,250 each in emergency cash assistance during payouts held at four centers on Saturday, Nov. 28, amounting to P58.5 million. The beneficiaries came from the drought-stricken towns of Solana, Peñablanca, Enrile, Amulung, Abulug, Pamplona, Sanchez Mira, Claveria, Ballesteros, Gattaran, Santo Niño, Piat, Tuao and Rizal, as well as Tuguegarao City. The distribution is part of a larger P173.6-million assistance program for 33,072 rice farmers in 25 towns and this city.
